name: yapper
description: Records meetings, transcribes them on-device with Whisper, and writes structured notes with the model you choose
author: Carlos Lopez

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Yapper records meetings with your microphone and transcribes them on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Yapper records the other side of your calls — the audio your Mac is playing — and transcribes it on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Only used on macOS 13, where capturing system audio has no other route. No screen content is ever read: the video side is reduced to 2x2 pixels and discarded.
